Input image is identity and wool-felt style reference, recreate its animal employees as small full-body art. All sprites entirely contained in their own equal grid cells, at least 12% space at edges, no overlap. Camera mildly down and front 3/4, faces and bodies oriented screen-right (30 degrees right), feet clearly visible, consistent size, high quality 3D miniature hand-sewn felt, big expressive eyes, softly lit from upper left, vivid colors. Character's silhouette is fully visible, no props on them, no furniture, no props next to them, no lettering, no watermark, no scenery, no grid lines, no ground or drop shadow. Fully transparent background including between sprites, never a checkerboard printed.
